headline: Congress takes a breather with pro forma sessions scheduled for Tuesday—both chambers adjourning early Friday before the long weekend!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on Friday morning and quickly adjourned. No votes, floor action, or committee meetings took place—a standard quick session held during recess periods to maintain continuity.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly Friday morning for a pro forma session, introducing 6 public bills and 2 resolutions before adjourning. Speaker appointed Representative Simpson as Speaker pro tempore. No votes or substantive floor action occurred.
